import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright'
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'

/**
 * 无障碍基线：关键页面不允许出现 serious / critical 级别问题。
 * 只扫常见结构性规则，避免把第三方依赖的历史问题全部算进来。
 */

const RULES = {
  'color-contrast': { enabled: true },
  'label': { enabled: true },
  'button-name': { enabled: true },
  'link-name': { enabled: true },
  'html-has-lang': { enabled: true },
  'document-title': { enabled: true },
  'heading-order': { enabled: true },
  'image-alt': { enabled: true },
  'aria-allowed-attr': { enabled: true },
  'aria-hidden-focus': { enabled: true },
}

async function scan(page: import('@playwright/test').Page, name: string) {
  // 入场动画未结束时，axe 会把半透明状态算成对比度问题，先关掉动画并等一帧
  await page.addStyleTag({ content: '*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}' })
  await page.waitForTimeout(400)

  const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).options({ rules: RULES }).analyze()
  const blocking = results.violations.filter((item) => item.impact === 'serious' || item.impact === 'critical')
  const summary = blocking.map((item) => ({
    id: item.id,
    impact: item.impact,
    nodes: item.nodes.length,
    help: item.help,
    targets: item.nodes.slice(0, 3).map((node) => node.target.join(' ')),
  }))
  expect(summary, `${name} 存在无障碍问题`).toEqual([])
}

test('登录页无障碍', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/login')
  await expect(page.locator('form')).toBeVisible()
  await scan(page, '登录页')
})

test('注册后的看板与场景库无障碍', async ({ page }) => {
  const stamp = Date.now()
  const email = `a11y-${stamp}@example.com`

  await page.goto('/login')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '注册' }).first().click()
  await page.locator('input[name="displayName"]').fill('无障碍测试')
  await page.locator('input[name="email"]').fill(email)
  await page.locator('input[name="password"]').fill('AxeTest12345!')
  await page.locator('input[name="confirmPassword"]').fill('AxeTest12345!')
  await page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '我已阅读并同意', exact: true }).check()
  await page.locator('button[type="submit"]').click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: '场景训练' })).toBeVisible()

  await scan(page, '成长看板')

  await page.goto('/scenes')
  await expect(page.locator('.scene-card').first()).toBeVisible()
  await scan(page, '场景库')

  await page.goto('/my-scenes')
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: '新建场景' })).toBeVisible()
  await scan(page, '我的场景')
})

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'

/**
 * 上线前的浏览器端到端冒烟：
 * 注册 → 看板 → 场景库 → 我的场景（创建/删除）→ 个人资料 → 未登录跳转。
 * 不依赖大模型：模型相关链路由 scripts/smoke_test.py 覆盖。
 */

test('注册后可以走完场景库、我的场景与个人资料', async ({ page }) => {
  const stamp = Date.now()
  const email = `e2e-${stamp}@example.com`
  const password = 'E2eTest12345!'

  await page.goto('/login')

  // 切换到注册模式
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '注册' }).first().click()
  await page.locator('input[name="displayName"]').fill('端到端测试')
  await page.locator('input[name="email"]').fill(email)
  await page.locator('input[name="password"]').fill(password)
  await page.locator('input[name="confirmPassword"]').fill(password)
  await page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '我已阅读并同意', exact: true }).check()
  await page.locator('button[type="submit"]').click()

  // 登录态：侧边栏出现，看板标题可见
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: '场景训练' })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '成长看板' })).toBeVisible()

  // 场景库至少有一张场景卡
  await page.goto('/scenes')
  await expect(page.locator('.scene-card').first()).toBeVisible()

  // 我的场景：创建 → 看到 → 删除
  await page.goto('/my-scenes')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '新建场景' }).click()
  const title = `端到端-后端开发-${stamp}`
  await page.locator('.editor input').nth(0).fill(title)
  await page.locator('.editor input').nth(2).fill('后端开发工程师')
  const questions = page.locator('.question-row input')
  await questions.nth(0).fill('介绍一下你做过的最复杂的接口设计')
  await questions.nth(1).fill('线上接口超时你会怎么排查')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '保存场景' }).click()
  await expect(page.getByText(title)).toBeVisible()

  page.on('dialog', (dialog) => void dialog.accept())
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '删除' }).first().click()
  await expect(page.getByText(title)).toHaveCount(0)

  // 个人资料：数据导出与注销入口都在
  await page.goto('/profile')
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '我的数据' })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '注销账号' })).toBeVisible()
})

test('未登录访问受保护页面会回到登录', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.context().clearCookies()
  await page.goto('/my-scenes')
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/)
})

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'

const answer = '我负责接口设计，先分析业务约束，再通过并发测试验证边界，并明确尚未验证的风险。'

async function register(page: Page) {
  const response = await page.request.post('/api/v1/auth/register', { data: {
    email: `functional-${Date.now()}@example.com`, password: 'FunctionalRepair123!', displayName: '功能回归', consent: true,
  } })
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201)
  return { Authorization: `Bearer ${(await response.json()).data.accessToken}` }
}

test('回答后立即同步必问题进度并锁定岗位，直接退出仍丢弃记录', async ({ page }) => {
  const headers = await register(page)
  const response = await page.request.post('/api/v1/training-sessions', { headers,
    data: { sceneId: 'scene-interview-03', evidenceDriven: true } })
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201)
  const session = (await response.json()).data
  await page.goto(`/training/${session.id}`)
  await page.locator('.setup > summary').click()
  await expect(page.getByText('粘贴目标岗位 JD（选填）· 面试官会按岗位考察点出题')).toBeVisible()
  const sent = page.waitForResponse(r => r.url().endsWith(`/${session.id}/messages/complete`))
  await page.getByLabel('输入面试回答').fill(answer)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '发送回答', exact: true }).click()
  const turn = (await (await sent).json()).data
  expect(turn.questionCovered).toBe(1)
  await expect(page.locator('.coverage-bar')).toContainText(`1 / ${turn.questionTotal}`)
  await expect(page.locator('.jd-bar textarea')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.locator('.setup')).toContainText('已开始作答，岗位和题目已固定')
  await page.locator('.plan-card summary').click()
  await expect(page.locator('.plan-list li.done')).toHaveCount(1)
  await expect(page.locator('.plan-list li').first()).toHaveClass(/done/)
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: '直接退出（不保留记录）', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/scenes$/)
  expect((await page.request.get(`/api/v1/training-sessions/${session.id}`, { headers })).status()).toBe(404)
})

for (const channel of ['VOICE', 'VIDEO']) {
  test(`${channel} 真实保存后可以修正转写并查看重评前后版本`, async ({ page }) => {
    const headers = await register(page)
    const response = await page.request.post('/api/v1/voice/sessions', { headers, multipart: {
      sceneId: 'scene-interview-03', channelHint: channel,
      turns: JSON.stringify([{ question: '请说明事务失败如何处理。', answer, startMs: 0, endMs: 4000 },
        { question: '你如何验证并发边界？', answer, startMs: 5000, endMs: 9000 }]),
    } })
    expect(response.status()).toBe(201)
    const sid = (await response.json()).data.id
    expect((await page.request.post(`/api/v1/training-sessions/${sid}/finish?create_plan=false`, { headers })).status()).toBe(200)
    await page.goto(`/report/${sid}`)
    const transcript = page.locator('.transcript')
    await expect(transcript.locator('li')).toHaveCount(2)
    await transcript.getByRole('button', { name: '修正', exact: true }).first().click()
    const corrected = '我负责接口设计，先分析业务约束，再通过并发测试验证隔离边界；还没有验证的风险会明确说明。'
    await transcript.locator('textarea').fill(corrected)
    await transcript.getByRole('button', { name: '保存修正', exact: true }).click()
    await expect(transcript.locator('.tr-text').first()).toContainText(corrected)
    await expect(page.locator('.replay-item').first()).toContainText(corrected)
    await expect(page.locator('.quality-notice')).toContainText('转写已修改')
    await transcript.getByRole('button', { name: '用新文本重新评分', exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.locator('.revisions')).toContainText('当前第 2 版')
    const result = (await (await page.request.get(`/api/v1/evaluations/${sid}`, { headers })).json()).data
    expect(result.qualityStatus).toBe('VERIFIED')
    expect(result.revisionHistory[0].evidence[0].quote).toContain(answer)
  })
}

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'

/** 提示卡：文本训练里给出结构、关键词与提醒。 */

test('文本训练可以打开提示卡', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(120_000)
  const email = `hint-${Date.now()}@example.com`
  const password = 'HintE2E123!'

  await page.goto('/login')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '注册' }).first().click()
  await page.locator('input[name="displayName"]').fill('提示卡测试')

  await page.locator('input[name="password"]').fill(password)
  await page.locator('input[name="confirmPassword"]').fill(password)
  await page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '我已阅读并同意', exact: true }).check()

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'

/** 视频报告：逐题自评可勾选、保存、刷新后仍在。 */

test('视频报告逐题自评可保存并回显', async ({ page, request }) => {
  test.setTimeout(180_000)
  const email = `self-review-${Date.now()}@example.com`
  const password = 'SelfReview123!'

  await page.goto('/login')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '注册' }).first().click()
  await page.locator('input[name="displayName"]').fill('自评测试')
  await page.locator('input[name="email"]').fill(email)
  await page.locator('input[name="password"]').fill(password)
  await page.locator('input[name="confirmPassword"]').fill(password)
  await page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '我已阅读并同意', exact: true }).check()
  await page.locator('button[type="submit"]').click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: '场景训练' })).toBeVisible()

  const login = await request.post('/api/v1/auth/login', { data: { email, password } })
  const token = (await login.json()).data.accessToken
  const headers = { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  const scenes = await (await request.get('/api/v1/scenes?size=1', { headers })).json()
  const sceneId = scenes.data[0].id

  const turns = [
    { question: '先做个自我介绍。', answer: '我有三段实习，主要做后端开发。', startMs: 1000, endMs: 5000 },
    { question: '你最有挑战的项目是什么？', answer: '订单系统性能优化，接口从 800ms 降到 200ms。', startMs: 6000, endMs: 10500 },
  ]
  const video = readFileSync(new URL('./fixtures/room.mp4', import.meta.url))
  const uploaded = await request.post('/api/v1/voice/sessions', {
    headers,
    multipart: {
      sceneId,
      turns: JSON.stringify(turns),
      durationSeconds: '12',
      engine: 'pipeline',
      video: { name: 'room.mp4', mimeType: 'video/mp4', buffer: video },
    },
    timeout: 120_000,
  })
  expect(uploaded.status()).toBe(201)
  const sessionId = (await uploaded.json()).data.id

  const finished = await request.post(`/api/v1/training-sessions/${sessionId}/finish`, {
    headers,
    timeout: 150_000,
  })
  expect(finished.status()).toBe(200)

  await page.goto(`/report/${sessionId}`)
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '逐题自评' })).toBeVisible()

  const camera = page.getByLabel('镜头位置合适').first()
  await camera.check()
  const note = page.locator('.self-review input.note').first()
  await note.fill('开场可以再直接一点')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '保存自评' }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /已保存/ })).toBeVisible()

  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByLabel('镜头位置合适').first()).toBeChecked()
  await expect(page.locator('.self-review input.note').first()).toHaveValue('开场可以再直接一点')
})

import { createRouter, createWebHistory } from 'vue-router'

import { useAuth } from '@/composables/useAuth'

const router = createRouter({
  history: createWebHistory(),
  routes: [
    { path: '/login', name: 'login', component: () => import('@/views/LoginView.vue'), meta: { public: true } },
    { path: '/reset-password', name: 'reset-password', component: () => import('@/views/ResetPasswordView.vue'), meta: { public: true, openToSignedIn: true } },
    { path: '/verify-email', name: 'verify-email', component: () => import('@/views/VerifyEmailView.vue'), meta: { public: true, openToSignedIn: true } },
    { path: '/privacy', name: 'privacy', component: () => import('@/views/PrivacyView.vue'), meta: { public: true, openToSignedIn: true } },
    { path: '/', name: 'dashboard', component: () => import('@/views/DashboardView.vue') },
    { path: '/voice', name: 'voice', component: () => import('@/views/VoiceCallView.vue') },
    { path: '/video', name: 'video', component: () => import('@/views/VideoInterviewView.vue') },
    { path: '/scenes', name: 'scenes', component: () => import('@/views/ScenesView.vue') },
    { path: '/my-scenes', redirect: { name: 'scenes', query: { tab: 'mine' } } },
    { path: '/scripts', name: 'scripts', component: () => import('@/views/ScriptStudioView.vue') },
    { path: '/scripts/saved', name: 'saved-scripts', component: () => import('@/views/SavedScriptsView.vue') },
    { path: '/favorites', name: 'favorites', component: () => import('@/views/FavoritesView.vue') },
    { path: '/history', name: 'training-history', component: () => import('@/views/TrainingHistoryView.vue') },
    { path: '/mistakes', redirect: '/scripts' },
    { path: '/profile', name: 'profile', component: () => import('@/views/ProfileView.vue') },
    { path: '/training/:id', name: 'training', component: () => import('@/views/TrainingView.vue') },
    { path: '/report/:id', name: 'report', component: () => import('@/views/ReportView.vue') },
    { path: '/plan-lesson', name: 'plan-lesson', alias: '/legacy-lesson', component: () => import('@/views/LegacyLessonView.vue') },
    { path: '/plans', name: 'training-plans', component: () => import('@/views/TrainingPlansView.vue') },
    { path: '/plans/:id', name: 'training-plan', component: () => import('@/views/TrainingPlanView.vue') },
    { path: '/admin', name: 'admin', component: () => import('@/views/AdminView.vue'), meta: { admin: true } },
    { path: '/admin/learners/:id', name: 'admin-learner', component: () => import('@/views/LearnerReportView.vue'), meta: { admin: true } },
    { path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', redirect: '/' },
  ],
  scrollBehavior: () => ({ top: 0 }),
})

router.beforeEach(async (to) => {
  const auth = useAuth()
  if (!auth.initialized.value) await auth.restore()
  if (to.meta.public) {
    if (to.meta.openToSignedIn) return true
    return auth.user.value ? { name: auth.user.value.role === 'ADMIN' ? 'admin' : 'dashboard' } : true
  }
  if (!auth.user.value) return { name: 'login', query: { redirect: to.fullPath } }
  if (to.meta.admin && auth.user.value.role !== 'ADMIN') return { name: 'dashboard' }
  if (auth.user.value.role === 'ADMIN' && to.name !== 'admin' && to.name !== 'profile' && to.name !== 'admin-learner') return { name: 'admin' }
  return true
})

export default router
